## Description

Provide a brief summary of the changes made and the problem they solve.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Architectural / Refactoring improvement
- [ ] UI / Accessibility / Responsive fix
- [ ] Testing & Documentation update

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with 0 warnings/errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes all unit tests
- [ ] `npm run build` generates clean production bundle
- [ ] Tested responsive layouts on mobile, tablet, and desktop
- [ ] Row Level Security (RLS) policies verified for database tables
